summary.text: Jim Lucas is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 69, which he has represented since November 2012, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Chris Bowen and independent Tyler Henkle as his opponents in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Jim Lucas graduated from Seymour High School and served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
His professional experience includes owning an awning company.
Lucas took office on November 7, 2012, succeeding Democrat David Cheatham.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Financial Institutions and Insurance, House Public Policy, and Veterans Affairs and Public Safety committees.
